text: What are the most common estate planning mistakes? Here's a quick guide from Miller Harris Lawyers. Not updating your Will after major life changes, like marriage, divorce or the birth of children. Choosing the wrong executor or attorney. Forgetting assets like superannuation, life insurance and digital assets. Not having an enduring power of attorney. And if you have children under eighteen, not appointing a guardian in your Will. Procrastination is one of the biggest mistakes of all. If it's been a while since you reviewed your Will, our team can help. Speak with Miller Harris Lawyers.
